title: Roadmap
text: Two decisions shape every phase deserve stated front: Provider neutrality via new_llm_model_option(). never construct ellmer chat client directly. board exposes llm_model board option whose value chat-constructor function signature function(system_prompt = NULL, params = NULL) returning ellmer::Chat. extension reads option calls . Providers, model names keys configured globally via blockr_option("chat_function", …) — scope package. option always resolves usable function (falling back blockr.core’s default_chat), extension never needs handle missing chat backend. Narrow tools, auto-batched dispatch. LLM sees many small, focused tools (add_block, add_link, …) rather one monolithic modify_board. tool call dispatch update(...) immediately; stages change pending payload held inside extension server. Validation runs current board merged pending payload, per-tool feedback meaningful. assistant’s turn completes, accumulated payload flushed single update(...) call. combination gives us: LLM-friendly tool ergonomics (small, focused calls, easy describe). single atomic dispatch per user turn (one validation pass, one re-render, one logical snapshot point future blockr.session integration). “add link block” ordering trap disappears within turn — ordering stage operations irrelevant long final payload valid. staging layer central architectural deliverable package; every mutation tool thin façade .

text: notes structure: system_prompt messages argument captured new_assistant_extension() enclosing scope. system_prompt stays plain string throughout session. messages argument consumed seed client$set_turns() local reactiveVal name; reactive form rest server reads writes. get_board_option_value("llm_model", session) blockr.core’s accessor board options inside Shiny module. returns chat constructor chat_name attribute can surface later telemetry. accessor reads reactive value, wrap isolate() – chat client constructed module startup must re-fire option later changes. messages tracks recorded form conversation. append turn boundary (mod$last_input user’s submit, mod$last_turn model’s response completion) rather re-recording whole list — contents_record growing list turns O(n²) conversation. length(turns) < length(recorded) branch handles edge case something external (e.g. mod$clear()) shrinks client’s turns; re-sync rather diverge. return shape list(state = …) contract documented dock_extension servers (blockr.dock/R/ext-class.R). Every key state matches constructor argument name — makes ser/des coherent. live ellmer::Chat instance chat_mod_server return (mod) deliberately state. runtime concerns (tool registration Phase 2, turn-completion observers Phase 3), serializable, constructor arguments. Exposing externally — later phases need — separate decision ser/des.
code: asst_ext_srv <- function(id, board, update, ...) {    moduleServer(     id,     function(input, output, session) {        chat_ctor <- isolate(get_board_option_value("llm_model", session))       sys_prompt <- system_prompt %||% default_system_prompt()        client <- chat_ctor(system_prompt = sys_prompt)        if (length(messages)) {         client$set_turns(lapply(messages, ellmer::contents_replay))       }        mod <- shinychat::chat_mod_server("chat", client)        messages <- reactiveVal(messages %||% list())        record_new_turns <- function() {         recorded <- messages()         turns <- client$get_turns()          if (length(turns) > length(recorded)) {           new_idx <- seq.int(length(recorded) + 1L, length(turns))           messages(             c(recorded, lapply(turns[new_idx], ellmer::contents_record))           )         } else if (length(turns) < length(recorded)) {           messages(lapply(turns, ellmer::contents_record))         }       }        observeEvent(mod$last_input(), record_new_turns(), ignoreNULL = TRUE)       observeEvent(mod$last_turn(),  record_new_turns(), ignoreNULL = TRUE)        list(         state = list(           system_prompt = sys_prompt,           messages      = messages         )       )     }   ) }
